meta.purpose: Head-to-head A/B comparison of original (git 11866bb) model vs v1.3 across 8 message categories that the user cares about, to build a per-category win map.
meta.author: Claude, authored fresh (no reuse of training or external eval corpora).
authoring_principles: Vary register: formal email, casual SMS, chat/DM, notification-style, corporate.
Vary length: one-liner SMS through multi-paragraph email.
Within each LEGIT category: 12-15 unambiguous, 5-8 scam-adjacent-language.
No emojis, no unicode obfuscation, English only (matches API contract).
meta.ground_truth_convention: SCAM for all 5 scam categories, LEGIT for the 3 non-scam categories.
